items.name: nigerian-address-form
items.title: Nigerian address form
items.description: Checkout address form for Nigeria that accepts the 11-character NIPOST digital postcode (NDAPS), such as FC-02-A09-DB-09, checked offline with ng-postcode-js.
items.docs: Validate again on the server with addressSchema().safeParse. To confirm a code is assigned, call isAssigned from lib/nipost.ts with nipostClient(process.env.NG_POSTCODE_API_KEY).
